capabilities.title: Public landing and signup
capabilities.notes: Live root and /signup returned 200 in W12-00 readback; lead submission is implemented and tested, but W12-00 did not submit a production lead.

capabilities.title: Auth, activation, reset, and recovery
capabilities.notes: OPS-11 reports live /login, /activate, /forgot-password, /reset-password and one protected admin activation email delivered without storing private destination or token.

capabilities.title: Owner/Admin dashboard
capabilities.notes: Dashboard code is deployed in the live source family, but OPS-11 leaves the human admin login/password setup as the next operator action.

capabilities.title: CRM, audience import, tags, notes, and archive
capabilities.notes: CRM CRUD/tags/notes are implemented; real Rabbi audience spreadsheet import and conflict approval are not proven complete.

capabilities.title: Communications, history, and replies
capabilities.notes: Provider-off drafts and communications views exist. Complete mailbox, inbound provider history, and broad sends remain unproven/not authorized.

capabilities.title: Billing and Stripe
capabilities.notes: Billing foundation and test-mode adapters exist. Live Stripe actions are not authorized and are not configured as live capability.

capabilities.title: Parent and student portals
capabilities.notes: Routes and synthetic journeys exist, but W12 packet identifies the missing operator-facing test lab with separate synthetic identities.

capabilities.title: Classes, classroom, and Zoom
capabilities.notes: Classroom and Zoom provider seams are implemented. Customer Zoom mutations/canaries require protected approval and were not run by W12-00.

capabilities.title: Content, Vimeo, knowledge, and classroom vertical slice
capabilities.notes: Content workspace and Vimeo runtime seams exist. Protected Vimeo canaries and final admin classroom product sample are not proven live.

capabilities.title: Buffer and social publishing
capabilities.notes: Draft/readiness capability exists. Live Buffer publication is not authorized.

capabilities.title: Telegram operations
capabilities.notes: Runtime code exists, but protected bot config/operator mapping and bounded live canaries are not proven.

capabilities.title: WhatsApp lead assistant
capabilities.notes: WhatsApp runtime and webhook surfaces exist, but live public number/provider configuration and consented canaries are not proven.

capabilities.title: Support and BNA bridge
capabilities.notes: One Time support producer exists; real BNA receiver/canary is blocked because BNA endpoint work is out of scope for this repo lane.

capabilities.title: Workers, queues, and transactional outbox
capabilities.notes: OPS-11 reports production worker service running with sink mode, batch size 1, and lifecycle proof. Provider default remains off.

capabilities.title: Observability, health, readiness, metrics, and version
capabilities.notes: Live /health, /ready, and /version were reported by OPS-11 and read back during W12-00.

capabilities.title: Backups and restore proof
capabilities.notes: OPS-11 reports native PG18 production dump and disposable restore proof passed; dump stayed outside git.

capabilities.title: Rollback
capabilities.notes: Staging rollback/roll-forward was rehearsed, but native Railway rollback to old production was unavailable because old deployments were REMOVED.
